items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 235:1
items.html: The Mochin of the upper AVI are the secret of the Mem of the Tzelem and the aspect of covered Hassadim, and they are the aspect of surrounding lights for ZON, for they receive only from YESHSUT, which are the Lamed of the Tzelem and the aspect of revealed Hassadim. However, when ZON are in smallness, then Ima, who is YESHSUT, is in the secret of one who crouches over her children, and she bestows to them then only the aspect of the Hassadim of the upper AVI, which are surrounding lights, and not from her own aspect, for they are not yet fit for revealed Hassadim. Therefore it is discerned that Ima crouches over him in the secret of surrounding lights, for these Mochin of AVI are only the aspect of surrounding lights for ZON, and not inner lights. (Item 205, and in the Inner Light there, Sub Header, "spreads").
